Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the replacement procedure, which must be 
 performed for main air filters when filters differential pressure is greater 
 than 4 inch water gauge, or emergency door open. Changing filters depending on 
 ∆P according to the weather of Mahmoudia city.
Main air filters are used to clean the air to the main 
 compressor from dust, small particlesetc
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. El said Mahmoud El makhzangy, tested by eng Ahmed Ahmed Elseady , and 
 revised by MDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Khamis Abd El Aziz El Sheriff and approved by eng. Abd El Moety 
 El Rakaiby the head sector of Mahmoudia power station. This document 
 certified 
 by eng. Samer Abd El Gilil MDEPC inspection & quality control general manager MPIS coordinator 
 and accepted by eng. Mohamed Nageb MDEPC inspection &quality control head sector

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover".... etc
Turbine must be shutdown
Fire fighting system must be out 
 of service.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Rags, cleaning fluid
Work to be 
carried out
Measure pressure difference for main air filters
Disassembly the old filters.
Inspect air diffusers and 
 diffusers brackets for broken and cracks (replace it if needed)
Assembly the new filters and tight 
 the filters supports
Measure pressure difference for main air filters
